lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Hi! Okay, I'm sharing. Tell me when you can see a very boring piece of paper.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: I see it. Oh, wow. That is boring.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Thank you. I worked really hard on it. So, this is one inspection. Up top, the site and the inspector, and the date. Big enough to read from across a desk.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Then the photos, each with the time it was taken right under it. Then the findings. And down at the bottom, the signature, the time it was signed, and this little check code.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Can we flip the middle? Findings first, then the photos. The auditor reads the findings, and the photos are the proof.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Ooh. Yes. That's better. Findings, then photos.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: And how short is the check code?

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Short enough to read out over the phone. It's just there so somebody can check the file hasn't changed since it was signed.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: That's the whole point, really. My one rule is, it has to be plain enough that an auditor trusts it. If it looks like marketing, they're going to squint at it.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Understood. No gradients. No little swooshes. I will make boring beautiful.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Boring and beautiful. I'll take that.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Okay, logos. In my first pass I had ours and yours in the corner, and, um, it looked like a bake sale flyer.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Ha. No logos. Well, unless Ducal asks for theirs. Then a small Ducal one.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Small Ducal one, only if asked. Got it. And it's always one page per inspection? Even if somebody takes a lot of photos?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: One page per inspection. One inspection, one page. That's what they'll file.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Then the photos get a little smaller and you never hear me complain. Okay, let me read it back. Site, inspector and date up top. Findings, then photos with their times. Signature, time signed and check code at the bottom. One page. No logos unless Ducal asks.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: That's it. Can you turn it into a proper mock?

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: By Thursday. I'll fill it in from a realistic inspection, so it doesn't look like a template.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Perfect. And I'll ask Paris on Friday whether their auditor wants anything else on it.

lines.speaker: mercutio_escalus
lines.text: Great. Okay, I'm off to make boring things. Honestly, best afternoon of my week.
